parsed.name: UDP扫描段接收器
parsed.description: 一个非物理的软件网络组件，用于在指定UDP端口上等待并接收新的扫描段数据包，同时返回发送方IP地址，以便在实验测量系统中区分数据来源传感器。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software network component that waits for and receives new scan-segment packets on a specified UDP port, returning the sender IP address so sensors can be identified in laboratory measurement systems.

actions.description: 接收新的扫描段数据并返回发送方IP地址。
actions.description_en: Receive a new scan segment and return the sender IP address.
